profile.summary: marwahaha is a **Senior JavaScript developer** with deep expertise in **date/time manipulation**, **TypeScript**, and **internationalization**. Their contributions to Moment.js demonstrate a strong ability to handle **edge cases in date logic**, **locale-specific parsing/formatting**, and **ISO 8601 compliance**. They excel in **performance optimization**, **code quality improvements**, and **breaking change management**, with hands-on experience in **testing (Coveralls, npm scripts)** and **CI/CD workflows**. Their work shows a **high level of technical precision**, particularly in **type safety**, **format token design**, and **cross-language date handling** (e.g., Arabic, Spanish locales). While their focus is specialized in time libraries, their **TypeScript and JavaScript fundamentals** are robust, making them a valuable asset for projects requiring **reliable date/time systems** or **globalized applications**.
